title: Operational local DB + committed ops ledger for issue logs and discrepancies
author: Pukujan
body_excerpt:
## Goal

Add an **operational local database** plus a **separate committed storage tree in this repo** that regularly records context, issue logs, and discrepancies — so product and coordination agents can find collisions, stale claims, and GitHub-vs-local disagreements without treating SQLite as authority.
